title: Decision measurement: qualify the frozen clamp without pooling
hypothesis: Removing reactive capture compression improves sustained success by preserving the grasp on an independently frozen promotion panel.

prediction.rationale: Retrospective pooling does not satisfy the standing promotion rule. This is the required qualification measurement, not another curl-mechanism experiment: test only the already frozen clamp on 30 fresh promotion cases. A larger replacement gate would require an explicit rule change.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r077_clamp_qualification --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r077_clamp_qualification"'
code_changes: New study module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/clamp_qualification.py registered as --study r077_clamp_qualification in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in the research_protocols block of config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Parent config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent and the exact D-052 clamp (R-065's curl_clamp substitution), hashes checked; offline identity gate at factor 1.0 on D-050's archived observations before any episode.

One frozen 40-case Stage-3 manifest on seed 4653 at config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_r077_block_s4653.yaml: cases 0-9 unused, cases 10-39 the promotion panel; placement-disjoint from every committed pen-spin manifest. Parent and clamp each run the panel in their own fresh process: 60 episodes, zero LLM calls. No candidate selection, no sample extension, no retry.

Seed bookkeeping: the research briefing now distinguishes seeds reserved by an open idea's own frozen manifest from seeds consumed by an executed run, so freezing a protocol's manifest before approval no longer reads as seed reuse; all consumed seeds stay unavailable.

Primary: clamp minus parent paired sustained success on the 30 promotion cases with the 95% t interval; prediction at least +0.05; refuted if the upper bound is below +0.05; an interval spanning +0.05 leaves the magnitude inconclusive. Qualification (the standing strict rule): positive difference and lower bound above zero; downstream repair additionally requires no observed drop increase. Reported: paired success and drop differences with intervals and win/loss/tie, failure split, in-play mean |spin|, drive and executed-action saturation. Decision artifact naming the qualified repair parent (if any) for R-078/R-079. Held-out split untouched.

falsified_by: The paired interval upper bound is below +0.05; an interval spanning +0.05 leaves the magnitude inconclusive. Regardless of magnitude, a lower bound at or below zero blocks qualification.

approval.note: I accept the implementer's seed-bookkeeping correction: the refreshed briefing explicitly reserves unconsumed seed 4653 for R-077, resolving my prior objection. notes: Primary, predeclared (30 fresh promotion pairs): clamp minus parent +0.2333 [-0.0004, +0.4671] (13/30 vs 6/30; 10 wins, 3 losses, 17 ties). The interval spans +0.05 (and zero), so the predicted magnitude is inconclusive; the standing qualification rule (lower bound above zero) is missed by 0.0004. Drops 1 vs 2 (-0.0333 [-0.1528, +0.0861]), off-centre tail failures 1 vs 8, slow-spin 15 vs 14, in-play |spin| 4.62 vs 4.50. By the predeclared rules the clamp is not qualified and not eligible as a repair parent on this run; no retry.

Four 30-case promotion panels have now scored the same frozen clamp against the same frozen parent on independent fresh placements: +0.200 (lower bound -0.006), 0.000 (-0.219), +0.233 (-0.020), +0.233 (-0.0004); 44 vs 24 successes over the 120 pairs (+0.167, not predeclared, not a qualification). Together with three fresh panels (148 vs 101 of 480, drops 23 vs 68) the direction of the effect is not in doubt; what the standing rule cannot resolve on 30 pairs is its lower bound, since the paired standard error at this base rate is 0.10-0.11 and the observed effect is about 0.2.
Saturation: drive above 0.99 on 90-94% of recorded in-play steps in both arms; executed-action saturation 4.7% (clamp) and 6.2% (parent) of components.

Accounting: 60 Isaac episodes in two fresh processes, 0 LLM calls, about 2 min wall time. The seed-4653 manifest was reserved by this protocol (the ledger now distinguishes reservation from consumption) and is consumed by this run. No deviation from the approved protocol. Final-test split untouched.

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted at least +0.05 for the exact zero-curl clamp against the parent on 30 fresh promotion pairs; observed +0.233 [-0.0004, +0.467] (13 vs 6; 10 wins, 3 losses, 17 ties), drops 1 vs 2. The interval spans +0.05 and zero, so the magnitude is inconclusive, and the standing qualification rule (lower bound above zero) is missed by 0.0004: by the predeclared rules the clamp is not qualified and I record that as it stands, with no retry. The fact the rule cannot see on 30 pairs: this is the fourth independent promotion panel with the same frozen pair (+0.200, 0.000, +0.233, +0.233; 44 vs 24 of 120 pairs) after three fresh panels (148 vs 101 of 480, drops 23 vs 68); a 30-pair panel has a paired standard error of 0.10-0.11 here and the effect is about 0.2, so the strict lower bound lands within a hair of zero each time. Confidence 0.9 in the inconclusive label; the replicated direction is not in doubt.
verdicts.next_experiment: The qualification question has become a question about the gate, not the controller: four panels of the standing size have each come within 0.0004-0.02 of the rule while every fresh panel favoured the clamp. Options for the next triage: (a) a one-off predeclared qualification on three standard promotion panels (three manifests, cases 10-39 each, 90 pairs) with the same strict lower-bound rule applied to the pooled paired differences, which keeps the rule's criterion and changes only its resolution; (b) escalate the gate question to the user if the advisor holds that any panel larger than 30 is a rule change. Until then the clamp is not a qualified repair parent and R-078/R-079 stay deferred.

verdicts.reasoning: Against the measured frozen parent, paired_success_difference was +0.2333, with a 95% interval of [-0.000442, +0.467109] [logs/pen_spin/r077_clamp_qualification/summary.json].
